test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 3

questions.question: A man sold an article for ₹4,725 by giving a discount of d% on its marked price. If the marked price of the article is ₹5,400, then what is the value of d?
Two students appeared for an examination. One of them secured 15 marks more than the other, and his marks were 52% of the sum of their marks. The sum of the marks obtained by them was:

Laxminarayan deposited a certain sum of money at 20% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. At the end of 2 years, he received a total amount of ₹49,428. What was the sum of money (in ₹) deposited by Laxminarayan?
A bus is moving at a speed of 86 km/hr. If its speed is reduced by 54%, the new speed of the bus (in km/hr) will be:
Wasim travels 216 km at 54 km/h, the next 460 km at 92 km/h and the next 500 km at 50 km/h. What is his average speed (in km/h) for the whole journey? (correct to two decimal places)

A group of people consists of children, men, and women. 20% of them are children, 40% are men and the rest are women, and their average weights are 40 kg, 60 kg and 40 kg, respectively. The average weight (in kg) of the group is:
The average of the marks of 13 students in a class is 62. If the marks of each student are doubled, what will be the new average?
A typist takes 40 minutes to type 8 pages. How many pages will he type in 80 minutes?
Find the simple interest (in ₹) if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 9.5 years at 12% per annum rate of interest.

In a library, the ratio of the number of story books to that of non-story books was 4 : 1 and the total number of story books was 1200. When some more story books were bought, the ratio became 5 : 1. Find the number of story books bought.

Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 20 minutes and 13 minutes, respectively. Both the pipes are opened together but after 4 minutes, pipe A is turned off. How long will it take for pipe B to fill the remaining part of the tank?
The area of a right-angled triangle is 44 cm2. If the length of one of its sides containing the right angle is 10 cm, find the length of the other side containing the right angle.
If the mean proportional of X and 242 is 132, then find the value of X.
Mahesh bought a music player and sold it to David at a profit of 10%. David sold it to Rodney at a loss of 12%. If Rodney paid ₹2,420, then the cost price (in ₹) of the music player Mahesh bought is:
The present cost of a plot area is ₹107073. After a year, its cost increased to ₹158094. The percentage increase (rounded off to the nearest integer) in the cost of the plot area is:
If the lateral surface area of a cylinder is 620.9 cm2 and its height is 8 cm, then find its volume.(Use π = 3.14 and round off the answer to two decimal places)
A retailer sells two mobile phones at the same price. If he makes a 20% profit on one phone but incurs a 20% loss on the other, what is the overall loss percentage on the whole transaction?
Find the simple interest (in ₹) if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 8.5 years at 8% per annum rate of interest.
A shopkeeper professes to sell his goods at a 20% loss but uses a false balance and gains 35%. The actual weight (correct to one decimal place) he uses for 1 kg is:
How much will a sum of ₹66,000 become after one year if the interest is compounded half-yearly at 20% per annum compound interest?
